(75)chos 'khor chen mor bsngags pa kun tu bzang po'i 'khor lo mi'am ci yi zlos gar zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /(76)sdeb sbyor rkang bzhi mnyam pa'i bri

tei:div.tei:p: (75) chos 'khor chen mor bsngags pa kun tu bzang po'i 'khor lo mi'am ci yi zlos gar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// (76)sdeb sbyor rkang bzhi mnyam pa'i bri tta las yi ge bcu gnyis pa skye 'gro la gzhung gi dngos bstan ngo mtshar rtogs byed kyi cho gas/ rkang pa gcig kho nar rnam grangs spyir 4096 de dag yi ge bsdoms pas 49152 lci yang thun mong 24576 phyi mo 73728 mchis pa las/ 'dir thun mong du bshad pa'i tshig bcad gcig la lci ba 32 yang ba 16 yi ge 48 phyi mo 60 rnams yod pa'i prāsta ra'i mtha'/ nyis stong zhe brgyad nyis 'gyur byas pa'i lci ba 241 gi mtshams yang ba'i bya ba las bzhi yang ba'am/ brgyad lci ba 49 pa'i nang gses/ naṣṭa ma ba na ya ga ba ste thog ma lci ba mi mnyam pa'i grangs can/ a dhwa phred du nyer gsum dang*/ steng 'og tu brgyad stong cig brgya dgu bcu go gcig mchis pa las bzhi brgya gya gcig gi mtshams te urdaṣṭi nyis brgya zhe gcig gi mtshams nas zin pa'i chu 'dzin phreng ba'i prāstā ras khyab par dkrigs pa'o// (77)mtshan dpe yon tan rgya mtshos lhun sdug cing*// tshangs dbyangs thos pas ngan 'gro'i gdung ba bcil/ (78) /rnam mkhyen gting dpag dka' ba'i thugs mnga' ba'i// rgyal ba 'di dag srid zhi'i bla na mdzes// (79)

rang bzhin brjod pa/ mtshan dpe yon tan rgya mtshos lhun sdug cing*// tshangs dbyangs thos pas ngan 'gro'i gdung ba bcil// rnam mkhyen gting dpag dka' ba'i thugs mnga' ba'i// rgyal ba 'di dag srid zhi'i bla na mdzes// 1) dpe rgyan/ bsil zer can gyi skal bzang rab 'phrog cing*// phun tshogs pa dang dri bsung kun 'phro ba// padma kar dang rdo rje'i sems dpa' dang*// mig mi 'dzum rnams phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin// 2) gzugs can rgyan/ 'chi med lha rnams zla ba'i bdud rtsir rol// 'gro bas khyod zhal zla ba'i bcud la gzhibs// ston zla 'di ni cha shas ma gang yang*// zhal gyi zla ba mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ 3) gsal byed rgyan/ gzhan phan thugs bskyed mtsho las tshogs gnyis kyi// 'dab stong chu skyes bzhad las stobs bcu'i dpal// ge sar rab tu rgyas pas chos 'khor gsum// zil dngar 'phro bas skal bzang dga' ston 'gyed// 4) skor ba'i rgyan/ bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i dpa' bo dag / kha sbyor yan lag bdun gyis rtse mor rol// gsung dbyangs sgyu 'phrul 'khor los 'gro ba rnams// mngon mtho'i yon tan bdun (80)gyi rtse mor sbyor// 5) 'gog rgyan/ ston zla nya rgyas 'tsher ba'i gzi 'bar ram// gru 'dzin bdag po'i 'od zer snang ngam ci// 'gro ba'i kha lo thar par bsgyur bas nas// de ni bdud rtsi'i 'byung gnas mthu byin min// 6) don gzhan bkod pa/ rgyal bas chos 'khor rim gsum legs bskor bas// thar 'dod sdug bsngal gdung ba 'phrog par byed// khyod gsung dung phyur brtsegs pa'i chos 'khor 'dis// snyigs ma lnga bdo'i sdug bsngal drung 'byin phyir/ 7)/ ldog pa can/ shar gyi thig le'i 'od snang dag dang khyod// tsha gdung gzhil bar byed pa'i mthu grub ste// 'di ni bem po snang ba'i rjes su snyegs// khyod kyi shes bya'i sgo brgya gcig car dbye//

8) srid pa can/ ma 'thungs rab tu myos pa'i ka dam pa// ma phyis dri mas rab dben lhas brtson lam// kun tu grungs par ma byas dwangs pa'i chu// khyod kyis 'gro ba'i gdung ba 'phrog la brtson// 9) bsdus brjod/ rtsa ba rab brtan 'bras bu'i khur gyis ni// slong rnams skal bzang dga' ston rnam par rgyas// grib ma snum pa'i dpag bsam ljon shing che// 'di ni 'gro ba'i bsod nams skal bar thob// (81) 10) phul byung*/ lo dang zla ba'i yun du bgrang ba yis// bzlas brjod dung phyur brgya phrag yud la ster// 'brel tshad thar pa sbyor byed chos 'khor 'di// rgyal ba'i gzhan phan dag dang 'byed nus su// 11) rab rtog sgo 'phar gcod pa med pa'i mchod sbyin la// longs zhes dril bu'i sgra yis bskul ba bzhin// thar pa dam par myur du 'gro dang zhes// lag nas bzung ste g.yas su khrid pa bzhin// 12) rgyu rgyan/ 'gro la sman pa'i lhag bsam rlung shugs kyis// gsung dbyangs yi ge drug ma'i chos 'khor che// lan gcig g.yos pas sa gsum skye rgu la// phan bde'i snang ba gsar pa'i dga' ston sbyin/ 13)/ phra mo/ nam zhig bde ldan zhing du 'gro 'o zhes// dngos su tshig gis brjod par mi mdzad kyang*// g.yas nas g.yas su rgyu ba'i ngang tshul des// brda yis mtshon nas ston la rings pa bzhin// 14) cha rgyan/ ma la ya yi rlung gi dri bsung gis// lus la reg pas tsandan ljon pa ltar// kun nas kun tu rnam par mdzes de ni// tshangs dbang mgrin sngon rnams kyis byed nus sam// 15) rim pa'i rgyan/ (82)drang srong lag gis bum pa'i chu bsil de// spyi bor blugs pas lus kyi dri 'khrud bzhin// rab gsal shel dang nor bu snyog bral gyi// dpal rnams bskus so snyam pa'i nang mun bsal// 16) dga' ba/ chos 'khor khyod kyi 'brel tshad don ldan gyi// mdzad pa mchog 'di rgyal mchog 'jig rten du// bskal bzang sgron ma rnam par bkod pa las// 'gran zla'i dga' skyed mes pos btsal yang med//

17) nyams ldan/ lnga lam gyur pa'i pha rol chos 'khor 'di// bskor phyir mngon mtho'i rten la smon dgos na// skye srid 'di la sems shes su zhig ni// rtag gus sbyor ba lhod de shin tu mtshar// 18) gzi brjid/ chos 'khor 'dis ni thar lam sbyor ro zhes// srid la zhen rnams snying la 'jigs ma byed// gang la mi dad phyir phyogs blo can rnams// re zhig dbang med srid las brgal ma yin// 19) rnam grangs/ blo gros gsal rnams thos bsam mig sgrub phyir// gsung rab dgongs 'grel me tog tshal du song*// gzhan dag dal rten snying po blang ba'i phyir// rkang lag bskyod pa'i zlos gar dge rtsa bskrun// 20) kun phan/ lha chos (83)brtson zhes yang yang bsnyad na yang*// dang khar ma bab gom pa'i 'degs 'jog bsgyur// des kyang don ldan dad gtong phun tshogs des// chos 'khor bzhengs 'dis phal cher thar par dkri// 21) rgya che/ sna tshogs nor bu'i sgrom bu rnam mang po// gser gyi bye mas yongs bkang yon gyis kyang*// mi 'gugs 'bad med sangs rgyas sar sbyor ba'i// chos 'khor 'di ni mchog gi sprul sku nyid// 22) bsnyon dor/ lan gcig g.yas su bskor bas bde ldan zhing*// 'dren byed stobs ldan phul byung chos 'khor 'di// mos med mgo yu chil chil 'khor ba ste// gzhan gyi ngor ni dam chos zhes su grags// 23) sbyar ba/ chos 'khor dri med srid gsum 'gro ba'i skyabs// thar lam snang byed bsod nams mthu las grub// bden bzhi'i chos kyi blangs dor rnam par 'byed// khyod kyi tshe gcig dge sbyor yud kyis byin// 24) khyad par/ gsung mchog yi ge drug ma'i chos khor 'dis// nga dor mi brtan brgyad bkag mi mdzad cing*// khro ba ma yin zhi ba ma yin yang*// 'brel tshad khams gsum sa dgu'i pha (84)rol bskyal// 5) mtshungs sbyor/ zas gtsang sras dang rdo rje rnon po dang*// rdo rje 'dzin dang mig mi 'dzum pa dang*// padma ka ra rgyal dang khyod nyid kyang*// thabs mkhas chen pos srid pa ming mthar byed//

26) 'gal ba/ gnam lcags mkhregs pa'i rkang pa 'ja' tshon lus// kun tu rgyug kyang sa gcig dag tu sdod// spyan ras gzigs kyi gsungs dbyangs chos 'khor 'dis// srid pa'i gdung ba rtsad nas 'phrog min nam// 27) skabs min bstod pa/ gang la brten nas yul gyi dga' gdung la// lhag par zhen nas dga' mgur spyod rnams kyang*// 'brel yul khyad 'phags srid pa mtha' can zhes// bstod pa'i snyan ngag rol mo 'khrol ba lags/ 28) zol bstod/ bskal bzang 'dren pa stong gi yid can rnams// zhi bde bsil ba'i khyad 'phags lam la bkod// chos 'khor gyis kyang 'brel tshad srid las brgal// 'on kyang mchog 'dzin zhags pas khyod ma bcings// 29) nges bstan/ mig mi zum pa'i thugs bskyed lcags kyu des// bsil ldan 'gro ba srid lam 'phyan rnams drangs// drang srong mchod rten klu nad gzhil ba bzhin// (85)khyod kyis ngan song sgo 'phar dam por bcad/ 30) / lhan cig chos 'khor 'di yis gshin rje'i skyes bu dang// lhan cig me tog gzhu can dag ni khro// srid lam dub dang sras bcas rgyal ba rnams// dgyes pa'i me tog phang phung sil ma bsnyil// 31) yongs rjes/ skye rgu rnams la phan bde'i dpal sbyin pa'i// chos 'khor khyod kyi de dag 'bad rtsol dang*// ngal bas bsgrub pa'i 'tsho tshis ku mud dkar// grags pa'i dpal rnams yud la 'phrog par byed/ 32) shis brjod/ ngag yid spyod yul ma yin blo 'das don// 'phags bzhi'i bskyed yum sher phyin mdza' na dang*// 'bral med dga' mgur spyod cing srid pa la// phyi phyag 'tshal ba'i lam des kun la srungs// 33) rab spel/ chos 'khor tsha zer 'bum gyis gzi ngoms pas// srid pas bcings rnams srid pa'i mthar phyin pas// sdig to mun pa ngo skyengs gyur nas bros// chu klung kun kyang tshol du song pa bzhin// 34) dgongs pa can/ dung phyur dung phyur brtsegs pa'i chos 'khor 'di// lan gcig bskor (86)bas tshogs chen ma lus sbyin// yid bzhin nor dang bum pa bzang po dang*// dpag bsam ljon pa rnams kyis 'gran zla min//

25) (87) (88) (89) (90) (91) (92) ༈ bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan rnams ni/ mdzes mdzes chos 'khor che 'di la// zang zing dngos po rgya che bas// ji ltar bskrun pa'i tshul dag ni// bsnyel byang tsam du 'di na 'god// 1) /shog do bzhi bcu rtsa bdun la// dkar dkar rin sgor brgya nyer brgyad// yang ni gsum la sgor drug cu// nyo gla dang bcas brgya nyer lnga// 2) brdal gla rgya sgor brgya phrag lnga// mtshal la bcu gnyis spang mthil la// bco lnga gying por gor bcu gnyis// legs legs li khrir rgya gor drug / 3) sprag rtsir sgor bdun rgya dkar gnyis// snag tshar sgor drug sman tshe la// dkar dkar sgor mo bcu dgu dang*// ras khrar rgya sgor bcu bdun yin// 4) legs legs sham bur sgor bcu drug /mdzes mdzes gos chen sgor mo drug /rtags brgyad sna bdun sgor nyi shu// dra phyed tshar lor sgor nyer lnga// 5)dag dag 'khor spar gsum la ni// rgya sgor drug cu tham pa yin// gtsang gtsang nas ya bcu phrag bzhi// rgya sgor sum brgya bcu phrag gnyis// 6)yang yang nas la brgya nyer drug /sha rin (93)chig brgya bcu phrag gsum// mar la rgya sgor brgya gya gsum// smin smin chu rar nyi shu gsum// 7)tsha rin nyer bzhi bul tog la// bzang bzang rin sgor bcu dang brgyad/ mkhregs mkhregs lcags la sgor mo bzhi// li rin sgor mo phyed so brgyad// 8) bskol jar brgya dang dgu bcu dang*// legs legs ras la bzhi bcu brgyad// 'bras dor rgya sgor sum cu dang*// dkar dkar chig brgya phyed zhe drug / 9) spar gla dngul sgor sum brgya bcas// khyon bsdoms sum stong drug brgya dang*// dkar dkar drug cu re dgu bcas// smin smin legs byas thog tu smin//

10) mdzes mdzes zhal 'debs byung tshul yang*// mdzes mdzes mang sprug khyim bdag nas// mdzes mdzes rgya dngul rdil tshad gnyis// gnas par tshe sprug rdil tshad gcig / 11) legs legs lha dbang sgor zhe brgyad// legs legs a smon sgor zhe brgyad// lcags la ling chen bub gcig dang*// legs legs rna bla sgor mo gcig / 12) smin smin gyang sprug sgor mo bcu// ko ba dris mgon sgor mo (94)gcig / smin smin gla ri sgor mo bzhi// smin smin skya blas sgor mo lnga// 13) thang bsam sgor gcig 'jam tshe gcig /mdzes mdzes zhing tshe sgor gcig dang*// mdzes mdzes des tshe sgor mo gcig /mdzes mdzes 'jam mgon sgor mo gnyis// 14) legs legs rgo lha rgya sgor gcig /legs legs khang sprug re ba shar// legs legs thang tshe ko ba gcig /legs legs mkhar lha ko ba gcig / 15) bar du chod pa'i zung ldan/ 'byor ldan bsam gtan sgor bcu gnyis// 'byor ldan dkon dgyes ko ba gnyis// gla lpags gcig dang dis bsam grub// rgya sgor gcig dang rtsis 'dzin gcig / 16) gtong ldan zo dbang dril bu gcig /'jam mgon dril bu theg chen gcig lcags thab sta re lcags 'gu bcas// gtong ldan zhing che sta re gcig / 17) dad ldan rta srung bogs lcags gcig // gung sprug bogs lcags dum bu gsum// dad ldan 'phags nor phyug rnams kyis// rmad byung dge la 'brel tshul yin// 18) khrums stod zla ba'i tshes bzang por// rmad byung 'gro 'dul dpa' bo la// rmad byung ngo (95)mtshar rab gnas kyis// ngo mtshar rten mchog sgrub par zhus// 19)dbyug pa zla ba'i tshes bzang por// rab gnas 'debs ja sgor mo bdun// mar rgya nyer bzhi tsam khal bzhi// rab gnas 'bras la sgor mo bcu// 20) sha sgor bcu gsum gro khal gsum// yo byad phun sum tshogs pa bcas// ston 'khor 'dus pa rgya mtsho yis// phun sum tshogs pa'i rab gnas mdzad//

21) skyabs mgon mkhan por sgor bco lnga// skyabs mgon bla mar sgor bcu dang*// skyabs mgon rdor slob rnam gnyis la// rgya sgor phyed dang gsum re'i bab// 22) 'phags tshogs bla bran las sne 'dzin// bcu gnyis rnams la lha rdzas re// 'phags tshogs slob dpon nyer gnyis la// nas khal gnyis re dar sgor re// 23) de ltar thog mtha' bar gsum du// rnam dkar lhag bsam nyag gcig gis// rnam dkar dge ba dngos gtsang du// rnam dkar smon lam mthu las grub// 24) rmad byung dung 'khor 'di nyid la// rmad byung badzra sa twa ni// rmad byung bye chung so drug yod// rmad byung lan gsum bskor na dung*// 25) ngo mtshar ma ṇi padme ni// ngo mtshar dung phyur bzhi dang ni// bye chen gcig dang 'bum (96)ther brgyad// bye chung lnga yis lhag pa yod// 26) ngo mtshar chos 'khor chen mo 'di nyid ni// lan gsum bskor nang dung phyur bcu gsum yod// lan bdun bskor na dung phyur so gcig yod// nyer gcig bskor na dung phyur go bzhi yod// 27) lnga bcus dung phyur nyis brgya nyer lnga yod// brgya yis dung phyur bzhi brgya nga gcig yod// stong gis dung phyur stong phrag bzhi dang ni// lnga brgya dang ni bco brgyad nges par yod// 28) bar chod ma chod zung ldan/ legs legs dge la spyod pa'i skal ldan rnams// legs legs chos 'khor 'di nyid bskor bar mdzod// mtshar mtshar dung phrag stong phrag mang po zhig /mtshar mtshar nges pa 'thob 'gyur bslu ba med/ 29) /mdzes mdzes chos 'khor 'di la re re nas// bkod bkod grangs ka gong smos yod nges yin// mdzes mdzes ngo mtshar chos 'khor chen mo 'di// bkod bkod pa 'di mdzes pa'i rgyan gcig mchog / 30) slar smras pa/ gau ḍā ba'i sbyar ba/ ma lus lus pa med pa'i 'dren rnams kyi// stong dang snying rje ma lus bdag mdzad pa'i// mig mi 'dzum pa 'phags pa dam pa yi// yang snying yi ge drug ma 'bral med smon//

(97)1) be darbha'i/ sras bcas rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi// rang gzugs arya ma hā ka ru ṇa'i// sgra dbyangs chos 'khor 'brel tshad don ldan 'di// bzhengs pas srid pa'i mtsho las grol bar shog / 2) lho pa'i rab dwangs/ chos 'khor zla ba gsar pa'i lang tsho can// gsung dbyangs ri dwags mtshan ma utpal gyi// 'od kyis mdzes pa rgyas pa'i bsil zer gyis// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal tsha gdung zhi bar shog / 3) shar pa'i/ gang de chu shel dkar min chu las skyes// rā spang spang rgyus mtshan pa'i gru char des// srid 'gro nyam nga'i byin za gsod pa dang*// skye rgu'i shis pa mkha' khyab brdal bar smon// 4) bai darbha'i mnyam nyid/ skye ba'i myu gu 'di yi bskyed mas dbus// ma gyur yid kyi yul la 'jug rnams kyang*// srid 'gro cho nga'i g.yang sa tshar phyin phyir// kun mkhyen spyan gzigs go sar thegs gyur cig / 5)

gau ḍā pa'i/ tshe dbang rig pa 'dzin dang padma'i tshal// rin chen mtshan sogs dad gtong mnga' rnams kyis// lhag bsam sbyor ba shugs drag rba rlabs kyis// bzhengs pa'i dge ba rgyal ba'i rgyu ru bsngo// 6) lho pa'i nyams ldan/ sngon bsags bsod nams dpal gyis (98)'byor pa yis// bde ba lo legs phun sum tshogs ldan pas// bsam sbyor dkar bas chos 'khor 'di bzhengs dges// chos kyi dga' ston 'jig rten khyab gyur cig / 7) shar pa'i rjes nyid/ dpal ldan yon tan phun tshogs grub pa'i tshal// blo ldan rig 'dzin grub pa'i skyed tshal 'dir// skal ldan shing rta bsod nams stobs las 'khrungs// 'byor ldan mnga' thang sa la'i tshal ltar smon// 8) bai darbha'i shin gzhon/ bsod nams sprin gyi phreng ba ldan dus su// chos 'khor snyan par sgrogs pa'i mgrin ldan pa// legs byas rma bya'i mjug ma'i zlos gar gyis// bsod nams mkha' khyab 'gro la dga' ston sbyin// 9) gau ḍā ba'i/ bsgrims gyis sgrim zhing rab dkrugs rnyog ma bslang*// 'dod khro dbang btsan ngan 'gror dub gyur rnams// tsha dbal kun bcil bsung zhim kun mkhyen gyi// sbrang rtsi'i zas mchog zad med spyod gyur cig / 10) lho pa'i don gsal/ tshe dbang rig 'dzin rgya bod gnas kun tu// nyi zla'i 'gros bzhin 'byor pa gong 'phel du// spel ba kun kyang dkar po'i chos phyogs su// btang ba ma gyur 'gro ba yongs la sbyin// 11) shar pa'i/ dpyid kyi bu mos ri gtsang khri shing kun// yongs su bskor nas mdzes sdug gzugs (99)bzang gis// tshangs dbyangs sbrang rtsi rna ba'i bcud len mchog /bsil ldan ra ba dkar po'i gsos su spel// 12) bai darbha'i rgya che/ thar 'dod rnams kyis chos 'khor 'di nyid ni// lan 'ga' bskor bas dal rten don yod byas// phyis nas dge gzhan re ba mi dgos pa'i// legs byas bsod nams 'gro ba'i dpal du sbyin//

13) gau ḍā ba'i/ g.yas su rgyu ba gcig pu'i ngang tshul gyis// brtul zhugs dal gcig bzung bas srid lam bsnyil// thar lam dkar po'i sne nas legs zin pa'i// rnam dkar dge bas srid pa dong sprugs shog / 14) shar pa'i brjid pa/ bkra shis dkrigs 'dra'i bde gshegs gzi brjid 'bar// gtam dkrigs grangs mang dge mtshan ci dgar 'jo// sa gsum dpal sbyin rab dkar dge tshogs sprin// srid mkhar yongs dkrigs dge legs char 'bebs shog 15) lho pa'i/ bsod nams chu 'dzin ngos kyi 'phang na gnas// dge legs mtshams kyi nyi 'od gos dang bcas// chos 'khor chu ldan ma yis 'gro ba'i yid// dge la 'dod pas gzir nas don byed smon// 16) bai darbha'i mdzes pa/ chos 'khor drwi med 'di la 'brel tshad kun// 'od mi 'gyur bas phyag ring legs brkyang nas// bde ldan zhing du bde bar 'gro'o (100)zhes// gsung gi dbugs 'byin 'gro la sbyin gyur cig / 17) gau ḍā ba'i/ 'di yi phan yon bsam 'das rgya che ba// nongs pa'i go skabs ma rnyed mes po yang*// ci zhig nongs nas nam mkha' chung ngur sprul// rgya che'i yon tan 'gro la sbyin gyur cig / 18) ting 'dzin rab rtog chos 'khor sku mchog kun nas g.yo bas thar lam mi g.yo 'gro ba bem po rdo ba bzhin// lag gis bzung nas padmo bkod par myur du 'phen la rtag gus sbyor bas brtson pa bzhin// nyi mas nyin bzhin zla bas mtshan bzhin ltad mor lhags pas sgra brgya dga' nas bzhad pa bzhin// dge mtshan nyin byed 'od stong 'bar bas sa chen kun tu bkra shis snang bas kun khyab shog / 19) / ces pa'ang drin ldan ma rgan 'das ma'i dge rtsar dad gtong 'phags nor ldan pa tshe dbang rig 'dzin nas dpal yul rnam rgyal byang chub gling du dung 'khor chen mo bzhengs grub pa'i dkar chags su bris zhes bskul ba bzhin 7grub dbang padma nor bu'i mtshan gyi bla dwags dpyangs pa dpal sprul padma kun bzang bstan 'dzin nor bu'am/
bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la bag chags 'jog pa'i brda sprod kun bshad kyi btags ming sgra dbyangs padma'i myu gur 'bod pas bris pa dge legs 'phel// zhus sau/// /
